channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Ladies: Slevin's 0-7 helps Galway record opening victory against Meath
item.description: Kate Slevin scored seven points as Galway made a winning return to the Lidl NFL Division 1 with an eight point victory over Meath in Grangegoggen, Kells.

item.title: Lidl National Football League round-up: Kerry, Galway and Waterford off to winning starts
item.description: Kerry began the defence of the Lidl NFL crown with an impressive 2-9 to 0-9 win over reigning TG4 All-Ireland champions Dublin in Clondalkin.

item.title: Westmeath and Wexford open with wins in Division 3 as London denied late by Tipp in Division 4
item.description: Westmeath recorded their first competitive win under new manager Mark McHugh by edging out Sligo on a 2-14 to 1-16 scoreline at TEG Cusack Park.

item.title: Late Kelly goal steers Clare past Dublin in Division 1B opener
item.description: Tony Kelly's superb goal in injury-time saw Clare claiming a 3-18 to 1-22 win over Dublin in the sides' Allianz Hurling League Division 1B first round clash at Zimmer Biomet Páirc Chíosóg.

item.title: Cork deny Cavan late on while Mulroy goal helps Louth past Offaly
item.description: Cork came from seven points down in the closing 12 minutes to secure a 0-24 to 2-17 victory against Cavan at Páirc Uí Chaoimh this afternoon.

item.title: Cork and Kilkenny keep it to script with opening wins in Division 1A
item.description: Cork recorded their first competitive win under new manager Ben O'Connor in emphatic fashion by seeing off Waterford on a 3-25 to 1-17 scoreline at Páirc Uí Chaoimh.

item.title: Kennedy strikes late for Kingdom to deny Rossies early upset in Killarney
item.description: Tomas Kennedy's point at the death saw Kerry snatching a 2-18 to 1-20 win in this afternoon's Allianz Football League Division 1 first round clash against Roscommon at Fitzgerald Stadium.

item.title: Goals key as Mayo deal Galway opening defeat in Salthill
item.description: Mayo got their first competitive win under manager Andy Moran after edging out Galway by 3-18 to 2-18 in an entertaining derby clash in Salthill.

item.title: Armagh make impressive start with 12-point win over Monaghan
item.description: Armagh proved too strong for Monaghan in this afternoon's Allianz Football League Division 1 opening round clash in Clones.
